test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Price of five cars B, M, J, N and U are compared. Price of J is less than U, M and N. Price of B is the least. No two cars have the same price. Price of U is less than M. Price of neither U nor M is the highest. Price of how many cars is less than the price of M?
solution:
Given: Five cars B, M, J, N and U are compared.

1) Price of B is the least.

__ > __ > __ > __ > B

2) Price of J is less than U, M and N.

__ > __ > __ > J > B

3) Price of U is less than M.

M > U

4) Price of neither U nor M is the highest - It means N has the highest price.

So, the final arrangement will be:

N > M > U > J > B

So, Price of '**three**' cars is less than the price of M.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
